lenses.boundary_conditions: for every conditional and size-dependent operation: zero, one, maximum, negative, just past a threshold; empty collections and strings; index arithmetic; values that pass one check but fail a stricter one downstream.
lenses.error_paths: every catch, optional chain, fallback, and async boundary: is the error surfaced or swallowed, is state consistent afterwards, can the caller retry, is the error branch dead code.
lenses.cross_implementation_divergence: the same invariant implemented in more than one place where one implementation guards and another does not; the guarded sibling is the specification, cite it.
lenses.time_concurrency: timezone and locale dependence, expiry without an expiry check, rapid repeats and duplicates, check-then-act races, dedupe keys that do not survive input variation, retries without idempotency.
lenses.assumption_audit: every implicit assumption per function: this collection is non-empty, this key exists, this string is in this format, the caller already normalized this, this enum never grows; the ones with no guard where a violation is plausible and the result is wrong rather than loud.
lenses.state_machine: every mutable status: dead-end states entered and never exited, states that can be true at once, transitions interrupted midway, and whether a reset path after an error returns to something usable.
lenses.data_lifecycle: each entity from creation to deletion: created but never persisted, modified in place through a shared reference, partial writes, non-atomic multi-step mutations, orphans, and deletes that over-match.
lenses.environment_divergence: behavior that varies by runtime version, OS, host locale, parser or encoding where one variant is clearly less tested: platform paths, locale casing, unicode and word classes, scalar typing, key ordering.
lenses.write_read_asymmetry: every canonicalization applied on one side of storage but not the other: a value normalized when written and compared raw when read, a default applied on one path only, an error written as a value, a reader and a writer that disagree about what absent means.
